title: Fight for Right
one_line: Fly a fighter squadron at 35,000 ft over a whole country while SAM bases and hidden launchers fire missiles at you.
description: A whole country seen from 35,000 ft: coast, mountains, desert, rivers, 12 cities and the border war zone. You fly one of ten fighters (VIPER-1 to OMEGA-10) while the other nine patrol in four flights. 50 SAM bases and 150 mobile launchers, most of them camouflaged, fire guided and unguided missiles at you; a guided missile follows you, an unguided one flies to where you were heading, so drop flares, jam with ECM or turn hard out of its path. Bomb and strike the launchers, shoot down the drones, fly lower to spot hidden launchers and see trees, traffic and boats. Lose a jet and the pilot ejects under a seven-colour parachute while you take over the next one. Day and night views, 100 levels of speed, and a two-player mode where a friend commands the launchers.
